scientific_integrity: Analytical proof includes all finite m and fixed-parameter asymptotics. Finite exact and numerical checks are corroborative only. Prior general birth-death and opposing-zealot techniques are credited; independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the equal-quality complete-graph model with one A and one B zealot, m >= 2 susceptibles, and fixed response exponent alpha > 0. It is an explicitly modified symmetric two-zealot variant, not a claim about the heterogeneous, B-only-zealot model.
title: Flat criticality, boundary layers, and exponential consensus passages in a nonlinear two-zealot opinion model
